svg.text: Filming guide step 1: Down the line →

text.tspan: Your whole body and the club must stay in frame for the full swing.
Too slow for a confident result. Film at 120 fps or higher if your phone can.

svg.text: No verified fault found + unverified observation (UJ-3)

text.tspan: No verified
fault found.
None of the three faults in the rule table showed up in this swing.
That is a real answer, not a missing one.

svg.text: Weight appears to move toward the trail side at the top.
Outside the rule table, so no drill is given.

text.tspan: Dashed means unverified: AIcoach is not sure, and says so. Ask the
coach chat what this observation is based on.

svg.text: 5 saved swing clips · stored on the AIcoach server until you delete them
Comparing 11 Nov with 14 Oct: same fault, so keep doing the wall drill and film again.

text.tspan: Its result and key frames are removed and cannot be brought back.
Removes all your analyses, results, key frames and saved
swing clips. You will not be able to sign in again.
